claim_summary: An explicit target-rooted descendant-size identity determines the difference of the mean hitting times of simple and leaf-reflecting non-backtracking walks for every ordered pair of distinct vertices of every finite unweighted tree, with equality exactly at a leaf adjacent to the target.
integrity: Finite exact computations check representative cases, not the universal quantifier, which is proved by the recursive excursion argument. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted trees; uniform first step; reverse only when degree one; vertex hitting means, not distributional order. The sign comparison is known generally; only the exact tree quantitative identity and its equality criterion are assessed here. Historical priority remains qualified.
title: Exact first-passage speedup for leaf-reflecting non-backtracking walks on trees
